summary: ICICI Bank Limited filed a Form 6-K reporting the outcome of a Board meeting held on August 21, 2026. The Board approved a revised limit for borrowings via issuances of bonds, notes, or offshore certificates of deposit in overseas markets, increasing the limit to up to USD 5.00 billion. This is a routine capital-raising authorization, not a special situation. No transaction terms, pricing, or strategic actions were disclosed. The filing is a standard foreign private issuer update to Indian stock exchanges, with no deal mechanics, advisors, or offer details. There is no risk-arb angle; the action simply expands the bank's external borrowing capacity.
